title: Verify Linux TERMAL_CLI resolution under the supported Codex sandbox
outcome: Record actual supported Codex sandbox PID/proc visibility and TERMAL_CLI behavior; document namespace assumptions without claiming support for arbitrary container wrappers.
acceptance: Run the configured TERMAL_CLI from a supported Linux Codex sandbox and record the observed result and PID/proc visibility.
Classify an observed failure with concrete evidence or document successful supported behavior; hypothetical arbitrary-container failures do not become a new parent landing condition.
